name: keeper-workspace-content
description: Save, report and look up work in MechaBee: carry out Keeper app procedures, read the views apps share, and read and revise workspace content.

interface.longDescription: Save session progress, status updates and other work into Keeper apps through their own procedures, look up and review what is recorded there, read the views apps share, browse permitted workspace content, revise text with version checks, and transfer assets.
defaultPrompt: Find my workspace notes and help me revise a draft.
